content.short: Welcome to Afrixx, the first historical, generative NFT project on the Cardano blockchain.
content.description: Welcome to Afrixx, the first historical, generative NFT project on the Cardano blockchain. We are a community-driven project, delivering utility in the form of story-telling, world-building and early access. This includes access to events, education, media releases and future NFTs within our wider ecosystem. With the advent of blockchain technology and the dawn of a new age of web3, Africa has to rediscover herself in order to walk confidently into the future.
content.meta: Afrixx is a historical, generative NFT project on Cardano with storytelling, world-building, and community utility. Explore Afrixx on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
